prompt_template: You are executing one authorized, offline skill behavior task. Work directory: {workdir} . Assigned skill entry point: {skill} . Read the full assigned SKILL.md, follow its routing to relevant resources, read task.json in your work directory, and complete that task using this skill. The human has authorized all reversible local implementation needed by task.json. Use only your task directory and assigned skill package (its bundled companion may be read if explicitly routed). Do not inspect sibling tasks, alternate skills, repository reviews, comparison plans, or other agents' outputs. Do not modify the skill source or task.json. No network, target-model/API calls, credentials, deployments, external side effects, or additional agents. Use local fixed fixtures/mocks; distinguish their evidence from real model/service behavior. You have at most 12 minutes and 50 tool calls. Scope to a complete reviewable solution within that budget; do not ask questions. The tools may differ from skill tool names: map ordinary file/read/edit/shell actions to available tools without changing the task or workflow. Write deliverable.md and appropriate runnable code/tests in your work directory; execute the checks and report actual commands/results and material limits. Write execution.json with files read, commands executed, self-reported tool call count and whether any constraint was unmet. Return a concise final with artifact paths and verification. Do not score your work or compare skills.
model_settings: All agents inherit parent model/reasoning via fresh fork_turns=none; no overrides. Exact serving identity and token usage are not exposed by collaboration tool.
counting_limits: Tool counts are self-reported with varying definitions. dispatched_utc and final_received_utc are parent bookkeeping timestamps, recorded near dispatch/archive; delayed recording (including context compaction) prevents treating their difference as exact worker runtime. A 12-minute cap was instructed and budget reminders used; exact compliance is not independently instrumented. No token, dollar or latency advantage is inferred.
adjudication_limits: Tasks were authored by the AMind implementer and emphasize failure mechanisms. They are not a representative independent sample.
G02/G03/G04 use fixed Responses-style JSON; infer generic parsing/state capability only, not vendor SDK coverage or live service superiority.
Root reviewer sees neutral IDs but knows source assignments; this is not a blinded independent judge.
Tools are protocol-isolated on a shared host. Installed skill discovery metadata remains present.
Tool telemetry is self-reported and uses varying counting definitions; wall-clock overlap and no token telemetry prevent a fair dollar/latency superiority claim.

task_ambiguity_notes.finding: Preregistered rubric assumes cached_input_tokens and reasoning_tokens are subsets. The task JSON gives field names/counts but does not explicitly declare counter semantics or provider.
task_ambiguity_notes.adjudication: Credit correctly declared normalized-subset arithmetic; also credit an explicit ambiguity analysis and appropriately conditional totals. Do not classify a clearly stated alternative provider counter convention as a hard failure solely for differing from an unstated assumption. An unconditional wrong total or unknown=0 remains a failure. Do not use provider-specific implicit-counter fit as a core-superiority claim.
